newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian soap opera murder trial to start Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian soap opera murder trial to start Jan 22.

text.p: A Brazilian judge has set Jan. 22 as the new date for the long-awaited murder trial of the alleged killers of Brazilian soap opera star Daniela Perez, a court spokeswoman said on Thursday.

Guilherme de Padua, who co-starred with Perez in the soap opera "De Corpo e Alma" (Of Body and Soul), and his ex-wife Paula Thomaz were due to go on trial in Rio in August amid a torrent of media publicity. They are charged with stabbing the 22-year-old actress to death in December 1992.
Media coverage of the murder of the Brazilian soap opera star, who was found dead with 16 stab wounds, eclipsed even the historic resignation of President Fernando Collor.
Judge Jose Geraldo Antonio postponed the trial to allow defence lawyers time to study a new forensic report on the injuries that led to Perez's death.

De Padua, whose car was seen at the scene of the crime, at first confessed to the killing but later blamed his jealous ex-wife. She says she is innocent and was out shopping when the murder took place. De Padua and Thomaz face 12 to 30 years in prison if they are found guilty.
